name: Power Pro Kun Pocket 5
original_name: パワプロクンポケット5
source:
Main character becomes an absolute star in baseball world. However, one day he exchanges bodies with a newcomer player. He can't return former body, so needs to start from scratch with the new sluggish body.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公成为棒球界的绝对明星。然而某天，他和一名新球员交换了身体。他无法回到原来的身体，只能用这副迟钝的新身体从头开始。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndreview[/url]]
